arguments.value: Andre Birotte, Jr. is a United States District Judge for the Central District of California, a position he has held since his confirmation in 2014. Born in Newark, New Jersey, he earned a B.S. from Tufts University and a J.D. from Pepperdine University School of Law. He began his legal career as a deputy public defender in Los Angeles County before serving as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California, entering private practice in Los Angeles, and then serving on the Los Angeles Police Commission as assistant inspector general and later inspector general. He also served as U.S. Attorney for the Central District of California from 2010 to 2014.
